passages.text: Then I said: “Hear now, O leaders of Jacob, you rulers of the house of Israel. Should you not know justice?
passages.sermon:
Micah is a prophet of God.
Micah speaks to the leaders of Jacob.
Micah speaks to the rulers of the house of Israel.
Micah says, “Listen now.”
Micah asks, “Should you not know justice?”
passages.original: וָאֹמַ֗ר שִׁמְעוּ־ נָא֙ רָאשֵׁ֣י יַעֲקֹ֔ב וּקְצִינֵ֖י בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל הֲל֣וֹא לָכֶ֔ם לָדַ֖עַת אֶת־ הַמִּשְׁפָּֽט׃

passages.text: You hate good and love evil. You tear the skin from my people and strip the flesh from their bones.
passages.sermon:
You hate what is good.
You love what is evil.
You tear the skin from my people.
You strip the flesh from their bones.
passages.original: שֹׂ֥נְאֵי ט֖וֹב וְאֹ֣הֲבֵי רָעָה גֹּזְלֵ֤י עוֹרָם֙ מֵֽעֲלֵיהֶ֔ם וּשְׁאֵרָ֖ם מֵעַ֥ל עַצְמוֹתָֽם׃

passages.text: You eat the flesh of my people after stripping off their skin and breaking their bones. You chop them up like flesh for the cooking pot, like meat in a cauldron.”
passages.sermon:
The leaders of Israel act with cruelty.
They eat the flesh of my people.
They strip the skin from my people.
They break the bones of my people.
They chop my people into pieces.
They treat my people like meat for a pot.
They treat my people like flesh in a cauldron.
passages.original: וַאֲשֶׁ֣ר אָכְלוּ֮ שְׁאֵ֣ר עַמִּי֒ וְעוֹרָם֙ מֵעֲלֵיהֶ֣ם הִפְשִׁ֔יטוּ וְאֶת־ עַצְמֹֽתֵיהֶ֖ם פִּצֵּ֑חוּ וּפָרְשׂוּ֙ כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר בַּסִּ֔יר וּכְבָשָׂ֖ר בְּת֥וֹךְ קַלָּֽחַת׃

passages.text: Then they will cry out to the LORD, but He will not answer them. At that time He will hide His face from them because of the evil they have done.
passages.sermon:
The people have done evil things.
They will cry out to the LORD.
The LORD will not answer them.
At that time, the LORD will hide His face from them.
He will do this because of their evil actions.
passages.original: אָ֚ז יִזְעֲק֣וּ אֶל־ יְהוָ֔ה וְלֹ֥א יַעֲנֶ֖ה אוֹתָ֑ם וְיַסְתֵּ֨ר פָּנָ֤יו מֵהֶם֙ בָּעֵ֣ת הַהִ֔יא כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר הֵרֵ֖עוּ מַעַלְלֵיהֶֽם׃פ

passages.text: This is what the LORD says: “As for the prophets who lead My people astray, who proclaim peace while they chew with their teeth, but declare war against one who puts nothing in their mouths: Therefore night will come over you without visions, and darkness without divination. The sun will set on these prophets, and the daylight will turn black over them.
passages.sermon:
The LORD speaks about the prophets.
These prophets lead His people astray.
They say they bring peace.
They do this while they have food in their mouths.
But if someone does not give them food, they declare war against him.
The LORD says night will come to these prophets.
They will have no visions.
Darkness will come to them.
They will have no divination.
The sun will set on these prophets.
The day will become dark over them.
passages.original: כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה עַל־ הַנְּבִיאִ֖ים הַמַּתְעִ֣ים אֶת־ עַמִּ֑י הַנֹּשְׁכִ֤ים בְּשִׁנֵּיהֶם֙ וְקָרְא֣וּ שָׁל֔וֹם וַאֲשֶׁר֙ לֹא־ יִתֵּ֣ן עַל־ פִּיהֶ֔ם וְקִדְּשׁ֥וּ עָלָ֖יו מִלְחָמָֽה׃ לָכֵ֞ן לַ֤יְלָה לָכֶם֙ מֵֽחָז֔וֹן וְחָשְׁכָ֥ה לָכֶ֖ם מִקְּסֹ֑ם וּבָ֤אָה הַשֶּׁ֙מֶשׁ֙ עַל־ הַנְּבִיאִ֔ים וְקָדַ֥ר עֲלֵיהֶ֖ם הַיּֽוֹם׃

passages.text: Then the seers will be ashamed and the diviners will be disgraced. They will all cover their mouths because there is no answer from God.”
passages.sermon:
The seers will feel ashamed.
The diviners will feel disgraced.
All of them will cover their mouths.
God will not answer them.
passages.original: וּבֹ֣שׁוּ הַחֹזִ֗ים וְחָֽפְרוּ֙ הַקֹּ֣סְמִ֔ים וְעָט֥וּ עַל־ שָׂפָ֖ם כֻּלָּ֑ם כִּ֛י אֵ֥ין מַעֲנֵ֖ה אֱלֹהִֽים׃

passages.text: As for me, however, I am filled with power by the Spirit of the LORD, with justice and courage, to declare to Jacob his transgression and to Israel his sin.
passages.sermon:
I am a true prophet of God.
I am filled with power.
The Spirit of the LORD fills me.
I have justice.
I have courage.
I speak to Jacob.
I tell Jacob his transgression.
I speak to Israel.
I tell Israel his sin.
passages.original: וְאוּלָ֗ם אָנֹכִ֞י מָלֵ֤אתִי כֹ֙חַ֙ אֶת־ ר֣וּחַ יְהוָ֔ה וּמִשְׁפָּ֖ט וּגְבוּרָ֑ה לְהַגִּ֤יד לְיַֽעֲקֹב֙ פִּשְׁע֔וֹ וּלְיִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל חַטָּאתֽוֹ׃ס

passages.text: Now hear this, O leaders of the house of Jacob and rulers of the house of Israel, who despise justice and pervert all that is right, who build Zion with bloodshed and Jerusalem with iniquity.
passages.sermon:
Leaders of the house of Jacob, listen to this.
Rulers of the house of Israel, listen to this.
You despise justice.
You twist everything that is right.
You build Zion with bloodshed.
You build Jerusalem with injustice.
passages.original: שִׁמְעוּ־ נָ֣א זֹ֗את רָאשֵׁי֙ בֵּ֣ית יַעֲקֹ֔ב וּקְצִינֵ֖י בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל הַֽמֲתַעֲבִ֣ים מִשְׁפָּ֔ט וְאֵ֥ת כָּל־ הַיְשָׁרָ֖ה יְעַקֵּֽשׁוּ׃ בֹּנֶ֥ה צִיּ֖וֹן בְּדָמִ֑ים וִירוּשָׁלִַ֖ם בְּעַוְלָֽה׃

passages.text: Her leaders judge for a bribe, her priests teach for a price, and her prophets practice divination for money. Yet they lean upon the LORD, saying, “Is not the LORD among us? No disaster can come upon us.”
passages.sermon:
The leaders of Israel judge people for a bribe.
The priests of Israel teach only if they are paid.
The prophets of Israel tell fortunes for money.
These leaders, priests, and prophets claim to trust in the LORD.
They say, “The LORD is with us.”
They say, “No disaster will come upon us.”
passages.original: רָאשֶׁ֣יהָ׀ בְּשֹׁ֣חַד יִשְׁפֹּ֗טוּ וְכֹהֲנֶ֙יהָ֙ בִּמְחִ֣יר יוֹר֔וּ וּנְבִיאֶ֖יהָ בְּכֶ֣סֶף יִקְסֹ֑מוּ וְעַל־ יְהוָה֙ יִשָּׁעֵ֣נוּ לֵאמֹ֔ר הֲל֤וֹא יְהוָה֙ בְּקִרְבֵּ֔נוּ לֹֽא־ תָב֥וֹא עָלֵ֖ינוּ רָעָֽה׃

passages.text: Therefore, because of you, Zion will be plowed like a field, Jerusalem will become a heap of rubble, and the temple mount a wooded ridge.
passages.sermon:
Micah speaks to the leaders and rulers of Israel and Judah.
These leaders hate justice.
They twist what is right.
They build Zion with bloodshed.
They build Jerusalem with injustice.
Because of these leaders, God will judge the land.
Zion will be plowed like a field.
Jerusalem will become a heap of ruins.
The mountain of the temple will become a forested hill.
passages.original: לָכֵן֙ בִּגְלַלְכֶ֔ם צִיּ֖וֹן שָׂדֶ֣ה תֵֽחָרֵ֑שׁ וִירוּשָׁלִַ֙ם֙ עִיִּ֣ין תִּֽהְיֶ֔ה וְהַ֥ר הַבַּ֖יִת לְבָמ֥וֹת יָֽעַר׃פ
